events.boundary: A national estimate cannot be assigned to a county, customer, feeder, household bill, or realized AI capability.
A scenario is not observed demand, an approved interconnection, a residential surcharge, or proof of strategic capability.
Reported revenue and capacity do not establish net public benefit, service costs, household incidence, water burden, ownership, or realized compute capability.
Policy terms and filings do not establish realized bills, defaults, enforcement, household fairness, or durable bargaining power.
The events do not identify facility exposure, duration-by-site, household service loss, independent causality, or long-run resilience.
The report does not identify which named facility used which response, event duration by site, household effect, customer cost, or the causal role of equipment or contract terms.
A filing/recommended stipulation is not proof of final adoption, customer acceptance, facility-level load, event participation, billed cost, cost recovery, or household incidence.
The proposal does not establish construction, energization, facility-specific load, customer causation, cost recovery, reliability improvement, or household benefit.
The values are a modeled incidence illustration, not an observed bill or payment; implementation, account-level allocation, enforcement, and public response remain open.
Docket testimony is not a causal household-burden estimate; it does not identify the facility, counterfactual bill, data-center share, payment hardship, or later household behavior.
This comparator does not establish data-center attribution, representative opinion, household bills, health effects, or the outcome of Prince William transmission cases.
Published service guidance is an institutional mechanism, not proof of a named customer's load, interconnection approval, construction, bill, cost recovery, or strategic compute capability.
This bounded non-observation is not proof that the effects do not exist; it records that the current sources do not support the join.
A possible-sale authorization is not a signed order, production record, delivery, acceptance, or operational availability.
The public announcement does not state the purchased quantity, acceptance, shipment, fielding, training, inventory change, or operational use.
The notification does not establish a signed order modification, changed quantity, shipment, acceptance, fielding, training, inventory, operational use, or geopolitical response.
A planned window is not evidence that any shipment or delivery occurred.

The audit documents missing numeric support and unreliable advance recording in the cited settlement context; it does not establish production, delay, non-delivery, acceptance, or fielding for the 2024 order.
This bounded public-source non-observation is not proof that no delivery occurred. It only prevents promotion to realized operational capability on the reviewed evidence.
The comparator shows that schedule, physical delivery, and settlement can occur on different clocks; it is not evidence about the JASSM-ER order.

cross_case_boundary: The ledgers show commitment, selected capacity, governance, and operational-stress stages, but do not establish complete accepted/operating capability, replaceability, household/partner incidence, or changed external behavior.
